author: Corey Belser (Cbelser32)
text: Excellent service from start to finish! The team was professional, knowledgeable, and easy to work with. They completed the job efficiently and made sure everything was done right. I highly recommend them!

author: Bradley Helm
text: Aloha Septic was great to work with! Zeb showed up right away, even earlier than expected, and was very helpful throughout the inspection and pumping. He clearly explained what was wrong and helped us figure out how to get everything fixed. They were on time, professional, reasonably priced, and genuinely helpful. I highly recommend Aloha Septic and will definitely use them again!

author: Michael Morrison
text: I have been turning to the trusted Aloha Septic for over a decade. Their knowledgable and friendly service has always left me feeling like I'm making the right call. We have a few generational businesses left in our area, they are one of them. You won't go wrong trusting Aloha Septic.

author: S Howe
text: Guys showed up earlier than promised and were actually done about the time their arrival window started. I already had the septic lids dug up and they quickly completed the county required inspection and explained what they found and my options down the road. They even scoped the outgoing pipe to the drain field to ensure there were no blockages due to my concern over some soil sinking in my yard. Highly recommend this company.

author: Gloria Salamone
text: Zeb was so helpful in explaining things over the phone and in person, taking lots of time to answer my questions. Price was reasonable with other quotes we received. I would definitely recommend Aloha Septic for any septic work!
